title: Practice Is Not Free: Measuring the Embodied Cost of Reset-Free Robot Practice
abstract: arXiv:2611.19979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a robot practices without human resets, every attempt still costs wall-clock time, actuator wear, and sometimes a person's attention, yet the schedulers that decide what to practice next treat attempts as free. We present an open, low-cost testbed for measuring these costs: a self-built SO-101 arm runs two demonstration-trained ACT policies that reset each other, with a vision-based success detector and a ledger that records the time, joint travel, and human interventions of every attempt. We formulate cost-aware practice scheduling, in which task selection is rewarded by measured competence gain net of embodied cost, and specify in advance the comparison that will test it. Its first two conditions, run on hardware for 51 minutes of robot time, show that a fixed retry limit did not reduce the share of execution time lost to failures (36%, against 27% for a feasibility rule; not significant) and saved no robot time. translated_title: 练习并非免费：测量无重置机器人练习的具身成本
translated_abstract: 当机器人在没有人工重置的情况下自主练习时，每一次尝试仍然会耗费实际时间、造成执行器磨损，有时还需要占用人类的注意力，然而决定接下来练习什么的调度器却将这些尝试视为免费的。我们提出了一个开放的、低成本的测试平台来测量这些成本：一个自建的SO-101机械臂运行两个由演示数据训练的ACT策略，二者相互重置，并配备基于视觉的成功检测器以及一个记录每次尝试的时间、关节行程和人工干预情况的“账本”。我们提出了成本感知的练习调度方法，其中任务选择以测量到的胜任力提升扣除具身成本后的净收益作为奖励，并预先明确了将用于检验该方法的对比实验。其前两个实验条件在真实硬件上运行了51分钟的机器人时间，结果显示固定的重试上限并未减少因失败而损失的执行时间占比（36%，相比之下可行性规则为27%；差异不显著），也没有节省机器人时间。日志表明……
tldr: 该论文构建了一个低成本开源测试平台，用于量化无人工重置机器人练习的具身成本（时间、关节行程、人工干预），并提出成本感知的练习调度方法，初步硬件实验表明固定重试上限并不能减少失败造成的执行时间损失。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an open, low-cost testbed for quantifying the embodied costs (time, joint travel, human interventions) of reset-free robot practice and proposes cost-aware practice scheduling, with initial hardware experiments showing that a fixed retry limit did not reduce the execution time lost to failures.
